figures.finding: A person under eighteen may not be appointed a director of a company, and an appointment in breach is void.
figures.applies: Kenya, Companies Act No. 17 of 2015 (Revised Edition 2021, the Business Registration Service's copy), s. 131.

sources.said: 131. Minimum age for director (1) A person who has not reached eighteen years of age may not be appointed to be a director of a company. (2) An appointment made in contravention of subsection (1) is void.

sources.title: Business Registration Service, Kenya (brs.go.ke/acts/): Companies Act No. 17 of 2015, Revised Edition 2021, s. 131
